ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Anik Industries Limited submitted its routine compliance certificate under SEBI Regulation 74(5) for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, confirming proper handling of share dematerialization. The Registrar and Share Transfer Agent, Sarthak Global Limited, certified that physical securities received for dematerialization were duly verified, mutilated, cancelled, and depository records updated within the stipulated timeframe. This filing indicates sound regulatory adherence and efficient share transfer processes, with no material red flags evident.
